activity_definition: Distinct current auth.users accounts with login, token_refreshed or user_signedup audit events. Aggregate only; includes automated session refresh and excludes unauthenticated visitors. UTC calendar days. Not a count of unique humans.
limitations: Resource snapshot unchanged; additional aggregate account and authentication queries on 8 October.
No write, load test or paid model call performed.
CPU-only projections assume linear demand and same daily burst profile; fixed work, memory, queues, IO, scheduling, provider quotas and network can dominate. They are not capacity certification.
Billing egress (about 24 days), recent daily authenticated activity (7 UTC days), service history (~7 days) and AI quota day (Brasilia) have different windows. Ratios are explicitly approximate.
Daily auth proxy excludes anonymous visits and can include session refresh without active human interaction.
Database growth of catalogs, auth history, indexes and bloat not measured per additional account.

documented_migration_options.authorization_scope: Documentation only, as requested by the maintainer.

realtime.proposed: Authenticated backend WebSockets; shared upstream Supabase Realtime connection per consumer process, or central consumer with internal distribution.
realtime.capacity_effect: Provider connection budget tracks upstream consumers and remaining direct clients. Backend socket/event/network capacity must be measured separately. Channels, event and provider transfer limits remain.

edge_functions.proposed: Port logic to backend Express services/routes or bounded background execution.
edge_functions.capacity_effect: Locally executed migrated operations stop invoking hosted Edge Functions; CPU, RAM, network and database demand move to backend. Proxying still consumes hosted invocations.
edge_functions.inventory_status: No supabase/functions source directory in inspected checkout; published functions need separate inventory.

documented_migration_options.pre_migration_estimates: Existing CPU-only backend daily estimate excludes the proposed WebSocket gateway and ported function workload.
